summary: What a day for Sandbach United! The Ramblers kicked off their 2026/27 season in style with a 3-1 victory over league newcomers Wednesfield CFC, with goals from Bevan (twice) and an early strike setting the tone for a dominant performance. Despite some freak moments and a resilient opposition, the team showed great promise with five new players gelling impressively in the starting eleven. Here's to many more wins this season!
